concept.title: Forward - Reverse Lever
concept.shortdesc: FORWARD (F) - Push the lever forward. The lift truck will move forward.

conbody.p: FORWARD (F) - Push the lever forward. The lift truck will move forward.
NEUTRAL (N) - Move the lever to centre position. The lift truck should not move when lever is in neutral.
REVERSE(R) - Pull the lever toward the operator. The lift truck will move in reverse.
